designDecisions.idColumn: text PRIMARY KEY, CHECK id ~ '^[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}$' -- canonical uppercase ULID (top 3 timestamp bits always zero).
designDecisions.hashColumns: entry_hash text NOT NULL CHECK ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'; prev_hash text NULL, same pattern when present.
designDecisions.payloadBindingFailClosed: id/prevHash/requestActor.tenantId bindings each require the JSON key present (jsonb `?`) and expected type (jsonb_typeof), with the equality comparison (where one applies) wrapped `IS TRUE`; together these make the whole CHECK fail closed instead of passing under SQL NULL. Genesis requires 'prevHash' present with jsonb_typeof='null' (no equality applies there); successor requires it present as a string equal to prev_hash.
designDecisions.selfLinkRejection: CHECK (prev_hash IS NULL OR prev_hash <> entry_hash), independent of the payload-agreement checks.
designDecisions.chainIntegrity: UNIQUE (tenant_id, entry_hash) plus self-FK (tenant_id, prev_hash)->(tenant_id, entry_hash) rejects any prev_hash naming a hash never written, per tenant.
designDecisions.singleThreadedChain: Partial unique index on (tenant_id) WHERE prev_hash IS NULL caps one genesis/tenant; on (tenant_id, prev_hash) WHERE prev_hash IS NOT NULL caps one successor/predecessor.
designDecisions.rls: ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, one FOR ALL USING/WITH CHECK policy on tenant_id = mfk_current_tenant(), reusing S1's attestation.
designDecisions.grants: SELECT, INSERT only to the runtime role -- no UPDATE/DELETE, matching audit_log's grant shape.
designDecisions.appendOnlyTrigger: Dedicated statement trigger mfk_policy_decision_log_append_only, BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE, always raises -- blocks the owning role too.
designDecisions.migrationChain: down_revision = '0002_customer_records'; downgrade() drops only this revision's trigger, function and table.
